entries.title: Psalms 74:1
segments: ¶<Maschil. Of Asaph.> Of God, why have you put us away from you for ever? why is the fire of your wrath smoking against the sheep who are your care?

entries.title: Psalms 74:2
segments: Keep in mind your band of worshippers, for whom you gave payment in the days which are past, whom you took for yourself as the people of your heritage; even this mountain of Zion, which has been your resting-place.

entries.title: Psalms 74:3
segments: Go up and see the unending destruction; all the evil which your haters have done in the holy place;

entries.title: Psalms 74:4
segments: Sending out their voices like lions among your worshippers; they have put up their signs to be seen.

entries.title: Psalms 74:5
segments: They are cutting down, like a man whose blade is lifted up against the thick trees.

entries.title: Psalms 74:6
segments: Your doors are broken down with hammers and iron blades.

entries.title: Psalms 74:7
segments: They have put on fire your holy place; they have made the place of your name unclean, pulling it down to the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 74:8
segments: They have said in their hearts, Let us put an end to them all together; they have given over to the fire all God's places of worship in the land.

entries.title: Psalms 74:9
segments: We do not see our signs: there is no longer any prophet, or anyone among us to say how long.

entries.title: Psalms 74:10
segments: O God, how long will those who are against us say cruel things? will the hater go on looking down on your name for ever?

entries.title: Psalms 74:11
segments: Why are you keeping back your hand, and covering your right hand in your robe?

entries.title: Psalms 74:12
segments: ¶For from the past God is my King, working salvation in the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 74:13
segments: The sea was parted in two by your strength; the heads of the great sea-beasts were broken.

entries.title: Psalms 74:14
segments: The heads of the great snake were crushed by you; you gave them as food to the fishes of the sea.

entries.title: Psalms 74:15
segments: You made valleys for fountains and springs; you made the ever-flowing rivers dry.

entries.title: Psalms 74:16
segments: The day is yours and the night is yours: you made the light and the sun.

entries.title: Psalms 74:17
segments: By you all the limits of the earth were fixed; you have made summer and winter.

entries.title: Psalms 74:18
segments: ¶Keep this in mind, O Lord, that your haters have said cruel things, and that your name has been looked down on by a people of evil behaviour.

entries.title: Psalms 74:19
segments: O give not the soul of your dove to the hawk; let not the life of the poor go out of your memory for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 74:20
segments: Keep in mind your undertaking; for the dark places of the earth are full of pride and cruel acts.

entries.title: Psalms 74:21
segments: O let not the crushed be turned back in shame; let the low man and the poor give praise to your name.

entries.title: Psalms 74:22
segments: Up! O God, be the judge of your cause; keep in mind the bitter things which the man of evil behaviour says against you every day.

entries.title: Psalms 74:23
segments: Keep in mind the voice of your haters; the outcry of those who come against you goes up every day.
